hooks.command: if ls ~/.claude/skills/tooluniverse-* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/tooluniverse-* ~/.claude/skills/create-tooluniverse-skill ~/.claude/skills/setup-tooluniverse 2>/dev/null && echo 'ToolUniverse plugin: cleaned up global skills (replaced by plugin)'; fi

echo 'If this question involves analyzing data files, scientific research, biology, chemistry, or medicine: (1) FIRST invoke Skill(skill="tooluniverse") to load the routing table; (2) THEN immediately invoke the matching tooluniverse-* sub-skill from the routing table (e.g., Skill(skill="tooluniverse-rnaseq-deseq2")); (3) ONLY AFTER both skills are loaded, run Bash/Read/Grep on the data. The sub-skill bodies contain domain conventions (which R function, which denominator, which column) that you will get wrong if you skip them.'
